card: This test-only PR adds functional test coverage for Tor control HASHEDPASSWORD authentication in test/functional/feature_torcontrol.py. The functional test suite previously omitted coverage for this authentication path, leaving regressions in Tor control command formatting or credential handling unmonitored. It introduces a mock Tor control server that advertises HASHEDPASSWORD to test correct password quoting, rejected bad passwords, behavior with an unset -torpassword, and unadvertised authentication methods. It has no dependencies.
changed_since_previous: No functional differences in the test logic; the patch was updated or rebased while preserving the four test cases.
evidence: PR description: "currently, the functional test suite does not explicitly explore this authentication path, which means regressions in tor authentication handling could go unnoticed. for instance incorrectly formatted AUTHENTICATE commands, broken fallback behavior, or authentication attempts being made when no password is configured."
problem: The functional test suite lacks test coverage for Tor control HASHEDPASSWORD authentication, leaving potential regressions in command quoting, fallback logic, or credential handling undetected by CI.

risk.why: Mistakes in test code would cause CI test failures or false negatives without affecting release binaries or node runtime behavior.

summary: Adds functional test coverage for the Tor control HASHEDPASSWORD authentication method in test/functional/feature_torcontrol.py. A subclassed mock Tor control server simulates METHODS=HASHEDPASSWORD responses to test four scenarios: sending properly quoted passwords on success, handling failure on an incorrect password, skipping authentication when -torpassword is omitted, and ignoring -torpassword when the Tor daemon does not advertise HASHEDPASSWORD support.
